narrative.northStar: Archivio curato nel tema originale di Checkpoint
narrative.overview: Covers lead the library and game detail. The original shadcn light/dark semantic palette and Geist typography provide the interface structure. Page layout and responsive behavior use Tailwind utilities in components.
keyCharacteristics: Original magenta primary accent and semantic light/dark tokens.
Geist for headings and body; Geist Mono only where appropriate.
Global search combines library entries and RAWG results.

rules.name: Theme source
rules.body: Keep palette values in src/styles/globals.css and consume semantic shadcn tokens through Tailwind utilities.

rules.name: Typography source
rules.body: Use the original Geist and Geist Mono configuration; do not introduce a second display font.

rules.name: Styling source
rules.body: Compose pages with Tailwind utility classes and existing shadcn components; do not add page classes to globals.css.

dos: Use the existing theme tokens in light and dark mode.
Use Tailwind utilities for page layout and responsive states.
Use the installed shadcn components for controls.
donts: Don't add custom page selectors to globals.css.
Don't introduce a replacement palette or display font.
